description: This file defines the AgentWorkflow class, which provides methods for tracking, executing, and managing workflow functions with metadata synchronization, event notification, and external communication via an agent interface.

classes.name: AgentWorkflow
classes.description: Helper class for managing workflow execution, tracking, and event notification within the AgentField system.

methods.name: replace_function_references
methods.description: Replaces an agent's function attribute with a tracked wrapper function.

methods.name: execute_with_tracking
methods.description: Executes a function with automatic workflow instrumentation, including context management and event notifications.

methods.name: notify_call_start
methods.description: Sends a 'start' event notification for a workflow call.

methods.name: notify_call_complete
methods.description: Sends a 'success' event notification after a workflow call completes.

methods.name: notify_call_error
methods.description: Sends an 'error' event notification if a workflow call fails.

methods.name: fire_and_forget_update
methods.description: Sends workflow update payloads asynchronously to the agent's server if available.

methods.name: _get_parent_context
methods.description: Retrieves the current parent execution context.

methods.name: _build_execution_context
methods.description: Creates a new execution context, possibly as a child of a parent context.

methods.name: _ensure_execution_registered
methods.description: Registers the execution context with the agent's server if not already registered.

methods.name: _safe_signature
methods.description: Safely retrieves the signature of a function, handling errors.

methods.name: _build_event_payload
methods.description: Constructs a payload dictionary for event notifications.

methods.name: _build_input_payload
methods.description: Builds input data payload from function signature, args, and kwargs.
